Continue existing repair-or-close, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Existing failures, validation, rollback, deduplication, isolation, and measurement gates remain unresolved; no new queue action is safely eligible this cycle.

Maintain financial containment. Continue existing period-aligned reconciliation only; preserve aggregate provider revenue as unattributed and retain unknown ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, budget exposure, and causal lift. Operating metrics must not be presented as financial returns.

Keep the gated product private and external outreach unsent. Continue only existing read-only rights, data-flow, consent, vendor, retention, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and security evidence work. Public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, credentials, permissions, configuration, dependencies, and security-sensitive releases remain blocked pending required evidence, counsel review, and owner authorization.
